content.definition: Arrangement where owner (consignor) ships goods to agent (consignee) who sells goods on behalf of consignor. Consignor retains ownership until sold.
content.key_principle: Consignor retains inventory ownership and risk. Consignee never owns inventory.

consignor_accounting.shipment_to_consignee: NO entry (or reclassify inventory to 'Inventory on Consignment'). Goods remain consignor's inventory.
consignor_accounting.costs_incurred: Freight-out, insurance → Add to consignment inventory cost or expense

sale_by_consignee.revenue_recognition: Recognize revenue when consignee sells to third party
sale_by_consignee.entry: DR Cash (or AR), CR Sales Revenue (net of commission), DR Commission Expense, DR COGS, CR Inventory on Consignment

consignor_accounting.consignee_remittance: DR Cash, CR Accounts Receivable (if not already recorded)

consignee_accounting.receipt_of_goods: NO entry (consignee doesn't own goods). May track in memo account.
consignee_accounting.costs_paid_on_behalf: DR Receivable from Consignor, CR Cash (or record in payable to consignor)

sale_to_customer.entry: DR Cash (or AR), CR Payable to Consignor (selling price less commission)
sale_to_customer.commission: DR Payable to Consignor (or Commission Revenue), CR Commission Revenue (consignee's profit)

consignee_accounting.remittance_to_consignor: DR Payable to Consignor, CR Cash

consignor_example.facts: Consignor ships goods (cost $1,000) to consignee. Pays freight $100. Consignee sells for $2,000, earns 20% commission ($400). Consignee remits $1,600.
consignor_entries: Shipment: DR Inventory on Consignment $1,000, CR Inventory $1,000 (or no entry)
Freight: DR Inventory on Consignment $100, CR Cash $100 (or DR Freight Expense)
Sale: DR Accounts Receivable (or Cash) $1,600, DR Commission Expense $400, DR COGS $1,100, CR Sales Revenue $2,000, CR Inventory on Consignment $1,100
If already paid: DR Cash $1,600, CR AR $1,600

consignee_example.facts: Same as above. Consignee receives goods, sells for $2,000, earns 20% commission, remits $1,600.
consignee_entries: Sale: DR Cash $2,000, CR Payable to Consignor $1,600, CR Commission Revenue $400
Remit: DR Payable to Consignor $1,600, CR Cash $1,600

balance_sheet_treatment.consignor: Inventory on consignment included in consignor's inventory balance
balance_sheet_treatment.consignee: No inventory reported (doesn't own goods). May show payable to consignor after sale.

revenue_recognition.consignor: Recognize when consignee sells to third party (transfer of control to end customer)
revenue_recognition.consignee: Recognize commission revenue when goods sold (agent, not principal)

costs_capitalized_vs_expensed.product_costs: Freight-in to consignee, insurance may be capitalized to inventory on consignment
costs_capitalized_vs_expensed.period_costs: Advertising, consignee's selling costs typically expensed by consignor (or netted against proceeds)

content.asc_606_consideration: Under ASC 606, consignee is agent (not principal). Consignor recognizes revenue for gross amount, commission as expense. Consignee recognizes net commission as revenue.

common_errors.consignee_recording_inventory: Consignee should NOT record inventory (doesn't own it)
common_errors.consignor_recognizing_revenue_at_shipmen: Consignor should NOT recognize revenue when shipped to consignee (only when sold to end customer)
common_errors.forgetting_commission: Consignor must record commission expense. Consignee records commission revenue.

cpa_exam_tips: Consignor retains inventory ownership until sold by consignee
Consignor: No revenue at shipment. Revenue when consignee sells to customer.
Consignee: No inventory on books. Record payable to consignor after sale.
Consignor's COGS = Cost of goods + Freight-out (if capitalized)
Consignment inventory included in consignor's inventory balance (not consignee's)

cpa_exam_strategies.identify_party: Is question asking about consignor (owner) or consignee (agent)?
consignor_key_points: Keep inventory on books until sold
consignee_key_points: Record payable to consignor after sale
common_mistakes: Recording inventory on consignee's books (wrong - consignee doesn't own)
Consignor recognizing revenue at shipment (wrong - revenue when sold by consignee)
Forgetting to reduce inventory when consignee sells

key_points: Consignor retains ownership until sold by consignee to end customer
Consignor: No revenue at shipment, revenue when consignee sells
Consignee: No inventory recorded, payable to consignor after sale
Commission: Expense to consignor, revenue to consignee
Consignment inventory remains on consignor's balance sheet
Revenue recognition: When consignee sells to third party
